book: BC exam drugs · EMR vs PCP
title: Drugs you already give as an EMR, and what changes
next: BC exam drugs, Lesson 2: New PCP drugs: glucose, nausea and allergy

slides.title: Today's lesson
slides.body:
As an EMR you already give 11 of the 18 BC exam drugs. Today, as a PCP:

  1. Review the 11 drugs with their exact BC doses
  2. Find what is marked PCP inside them, and what the protocols add
  3. Learn the new traps now that you have an IV and more drugs

BC source: EMALB drug monographs, guideline pages 58–78; protocols pages 47–57
slides.say: Welcome back. As an EMR you already give eleven of the eighteen drugs on the BC exam list. Today is about what changes for them now that you're a PCP. We'll do three things. First, a fast review of all eleven drugs with their exact BC doses, because the BC exams expect the BC numbers, not the textbook's. Second, we'll find every place where a monograph or a protocol gives the PCP something extra inside these familiar drugs. And third, we'll look at the new traps that appear once you have an IV and more drugs to combine.
slides.sayZh: 欢迎回来。当 EMR 时，你已经在给 BC 考试清单十八种药里的十一种。今天看看当了 PCP 以后，这些药有什么变化。今天做三件事：第一，快速复习这十一种药和准确的 BC 剂量，因为 BC 考试要的是 BC 的数字，不是课本的；第二，找出药物专论或流程在这些老药里给 PCP 多加了什么；第三，看看有了静脉通路、能联合用更多药之后出现的新陷阱。

slides.title: Eleven drugs you already give
slides.body:
AreaEMR drugs
HeartASA, nitroglycerin
Sugaroral glucose, glucagon
Breathing & allergysalbutamol, epinephrine (IM)
Overdosenaloxone
Pain & feveracetaminophen, ibuprofen, Entonox, methoxyflurane

Same drugs; the PCP gets new routes, new indications and new combinations.
slides.say: Here are the eleven, grouped by body system. For the heart, aspirin and nitroglycerin. For sugar, oral glucose and glucagon. For breathing and allergy, salbutamol and intramuscular epinephrine. For overdose, naloxone. And for pain and fever, acetaminophen, ibuprofen, and two inhaled options: Entonox, a mix of nitrous oxide and oxygen, and methoxyflurane. As a PCP you keep every one of these. The changes come in three types: new routes, like IV naloxone; new indications, like epinephrine for severe bronchospasm; and new combinations, like salbutamol with ipratropium. Keep those three types in mind as we go.
slides.sayZh: 这是那十一种药，按系统分组。心脏：阿司匹林、硝酸甘油。血糖：口服葡萄糖、胰高血糖素。呼吸和过敏：沙丁胺醇、肌注肾上腺素。药物过量：纳洛酮。疼痛和发热：对乙酰氨基酚、布洛芬，以及两种吸入药：Entonox（笑气和氧气的混合气）和甲氧氟烷。当了 PCP，这些药你全部保留。变化分三类：新途径，比如静脉纳洛酮；新适应症，比如肾上腺素用于严重支气管痉挛；新组合，比如沙丁胺醇加异丙托溴铵。往下听的时候记住这三类。

slides.title: Chest pain: ASA and nitroglycerin
slides.body:
• ASA 160 mg PO, chewed; the only drug that doesn't need vitals first
  • No ASA if they already took their dose before you arrived
  • Nitro 0.4 mg SL every 3–5 min while systolic > 110
  • Max 3 doses in 30 min, whatever they took before you came
  • No nitro: HR < 50 or > 150; Viagra/Levitra 24 h; Cialis 48 h
  • Pain after 3 doses, or systolic < 110 → Entonox 5 min later

PCP adds: IV with running fluid; consider dimenhydrinate for nausea.
slides.say: First, cardiac chest pain. Aspirin, or ASA, is one hundred sixty milligrams, chewed. It's the only BC drug you may give before taking vital signs, but don't give it if the patient already took their dose before you arrived. Nitroglycerin is zero point four milligrams under the tongue, every three to five minutes, as long as the systolic stays above one hundred ten. The limit is three doses in any thirty minutes, and the patient's own doses don't count toward it. If pain continues after three doses, or the systolic falls below one hundred ten, give Entonox five minutes after the last nitro. The PCP adds an IV with running fluid, and dimenhydrinate for nausea.
slides.sayZh: 先看心源性胸痛。阿司匹林（ASA）一百六十毫克，嚼服。它是 BC 唯一可以在测生命体征之前给的药，但如果病人在你到场前已经自己吃过推荐剂量，就不要再给。硝酸甘油零点四毫克舌下，每三到五分钟一次，只要收缩压保持在一百一十以上。上限是任意三十分钟内三次，病人自己用过的不算在内。如果三次后仍痛，或收缩压降到一百一十以下，在最后一次硝酸甘油五分钟后给 Entonox。PCP 另外加：开静脉并保持输液，以及用茶苯海明止恶心。

slides.title: Low sugar: oral glucose and glucagon
slides.body:
• Oral glucose 15 g PO; repeat every 5 min as needed, no limit
  • Only if the patient can maintain their own airway
  • Glucagon 0.5–1 mg IM, or 3 mg IN (repeat after 15 min)
  • Onset 15 min; lasts about 90 min

EMR: can't protect the airway → glucagon. PCP: IV and D10W first; glucagon only if the IV fails.
slides.say: Next, low blood sugar, which in BC means under four millimoles per litre. Oral glucose is fifteen grams by mouth, repeated every five minutes if needed, with no upper limit. The only condition is that the patient can maintain their own airway. Glucagon is half to one milligram intramuscular, or three milligrams intranasal; the intranasal dose may be repeated after fifteen minutes if there's no response. It takes about fifteen minutes, because the liver has to break down its stored sugar first. Here's the big PCP change. The glucagon monograph lists its indication as hypoglycemia when IV attempts have failed. So as a PCP you go IV and D10W first, and glucagon becomes your backup.
slides.sayZh: 接下来是低血糖，BC 的定义是低于四毫摩尔每升。口服葡萄糖十五克，需要时每五分钟重复，没有上限，唯一条件是病人能自己维持气道。胰高血糖素肌注零点五到一毫克，或鼻内三毫克；鼻内剂量十五分钟无反应可重复。它大约十五分钟起效，因为肝脏要先把储存的糖原分解成葡萄糖。PCP 最大的变化在这里：胰高血糖素专论写的适应症是「静脉尝试失败时的低血糖」。所以当 PCP 时，你先开静脉给 D10W，胰高血糖素变成备用方案。

slides.q: A man with chest pain used two of his own nitro sprays before you arrived. BP 138/84, HR 82, no erectile dysfunction drugs. You are the PCP. What is your nitro plan?
options: Give one more dose only; he has had two
0.4 mg SL every 3–5 min while systolic > 110, up to 3 doses in 30 min
No nitro: he already took his own
Skip nitro and start Entonox now
slides.say: Let's check. A man with chest pain used two of his own nitro sprays before you arrived. Blood pressure one hundred thirty-eight over eighty-four, heart rate eighty-two, no erectile dysfunction drugs. You're the PCP. What's your nitro plan? A, one more dose only. B, zero point four milligrams under the tongue every three to five minutes while the systolic stays above one hundred ten, up to three doses in thirty minutes. C, no nitro, because he took his own. D, skip nitro and start Entonox now. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 来检验一下。一位胸痛男子在你到场前自己喷了两次硝酸甘油。血压一百三十八比八十四，心率八十二，没用过治疗勃起功能障碍的药。你是 PCP，硝酸甘油怎么给？A 只能再给一次；B 零点四毫克舌下，每三到五分钟一次，收缩压保持一百一十以上，三十分钟内最多三次；C 不给，他已经自己用过；D 跳过硝酸甘油，直接上 Entonox。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B. In the BC monograph, the limit of three doses in any thirty minutes applies no matter how much nitro the patient took before you arrived, so A and C are wrong. Don't confuse this with aspirin, where the patient's own dose is a contraindication. D is wrong: Entonox comes only after three doses fail or the systolic falls below one hundred ten, and five minutes after the last nitro.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B。BC 专论写明：任意三十分钟内最多三次这个上限，不管病人到场前自己用了多少硝酸甘油，所以 A 和 C 错。别和阿司匹林搞混：阿司匹林是病人自己吃过就禁用。D 错：Entonox 只在三次硝酸甘油无效、或收缩压降到一百一十以下时才用，而且要在最后一次硝酸甘油五分钟之后。

slides.title: Salbutamol: what the PCP adds
slides.body:
• Neb: 5 mg if over 1 year; 2.5 mg under 1 year; repeat as needed
  • Adult MDI: 4 × 100 mcg; repeat as needed
  • Child MDI: under 10 kg not indicated; 10–20 kg, 5 puffs
  • Over 20 kg, 10 puffs; a course may repeat up to 3 times
  • Spacer for flu-like illness; BVM side port if ventilated

PCP adds: salbutamol with ipratropium in one nebulizer; in anaphylaxis, salbutamol after epinephrine.
slides.say: Salbutamol is a beta-two agonist: it relaxes the smooth muscle around the airways. By nebulizer, the BC dose is five milligrams over one year of age, and two point five under one year. By inhaler, an adult gets four puffs of one hundred micrograms. Both may be repeated as needed. Children by inhaler: under ten kilograms, not indicated; ten to twenty kilograms, five puffs; over twenty, ten puffs; a course may be repeated up to three times. The PCP changes: you can put salbutamol and ipratropium in the same nebulizer, and in anaphylaxis, the PCP list uses salbutamol for bronchospasm after the epinephrine.
slides.sayZh: 沙丁胺醇是 β2 激动剂，能让气道周围的平滑肌放松。雾化的 BC 剂量是一岁以上五毫克、一岁以下二点五毫克。吸入器成人每次四喷、每喷一百微克。两者都可按需重复。儿童用吸入器：十公斤以下不适用；十到二十公斤五喷；二十公斤以上十喷；每个疗程最多可重复三次。PCP 的变化是：可以把沙丁胺醇和异丙托溴铵放进同一个雾化器；过敏性休克时，PCP 那一栏在肾上腺素之后用沙丁胺醇处理支气管痉挛。

slides.title: Epinephrine: a second PCP indication
slides.body:
Anaphylaxis (all levels)Severe bronchospasm, impending arrest (PCP)
Adult0.5 mg IM every 5 min, up to 3 times0.5 mg IM every 5–20 min
Child0.01 mg/kg IM, max 0.5 mg, up to 3 times0.01 mg/kg IM, max 0.5 mg
  • BC exam route: IM only; onset 5–15 min
  • PCP trigger: SpO₂ < 90% and/or bronchospasm not fixed by salbutamol
slides.say: Epinephrine acts on three receptor types: alpha-one tightens blood vessels, beta-one makes the heart beat faster and stronger, and beta-two opens the airways. On the BC licensing exam, it's given only by intramuscular injection; in BCEHS, a PCP with additional training may also nebulize it for croup, in children over six months. For anaphylaxis, which every licence treats, the adult dose is zero point five milligrams every five minutes, up to three times; a child gets zero point zero one milligrams per kilogram, maximum zero point five. The PCP gets a second indication: severe bronchospasm with impending arrest, zero point five milligrams every five to twenty minutes. In the asthma and COPD protocol, consider it when the saturation is under ninety percent, or the bronchospasm stays moderate to severe despite salbutamol.
slides.sayZh: 肾上腺素作用于三种受体：α1 收缩血管，β1 让心跳更快更有力，β2 扩张气道。在 BC 执照考试里它只能肌注；在 BCEHS，受过额外培训的 PCP 还可以给六个月以上的哮吼患儿雾化给药。过敏性休克所有执照都能处理：成人零点五毫克，每五分钟一次，最多三次；儿童每公斤零点零一毫克，最多零点五毫克。PCP 多了第二个适应症：严重支气管痉挛伴即将停搏，零点五毫克，每五到二十分钟一次。在哮喘和 COPD 流程里，血氧低于百分之九十，或用了沙丁胺醇后支气管痉挛仍是中重度，就要考虑用它。

slides.title: Naloxone: the PCP can go IV
slides.body:
0.4 mg→0.4 mg→0.8 mg→2.0 mg
  • IM or IV, every 3 min until SpO₂ ≥ 94% and RR > 10; or 4 mg IN
  • Ventilate first; check glucose and correct it if ≤ 4
  • Onset: IV 1 min; IM and IN 3 min
  • PCP adds: still unconscious and apneic → IV naloxone
  • Watch for combativeness and withdrawal
slides.say: Naloxone blocks opioid receptors and reverses breathing depression. The BC ladder is zero point four, then zero point four, then zero point eight, then two milligrams, IM or IV, stepping up every three minutes until the saturation is at least ninety-four percent and the breathing rate is above ten. Or give four milligrams intranasal. As always, ventilate first and check the blood sugar. The PCP change is the route. If the patient stays unconscious and apneic, which means not breathing, you can start an IV and give naloxone intravenously, where it works in about one minute instead of three. Faster reversal can also mean faster combativeness and withdrawal, so be ready.
slides.sayZh: 纳洛酮阻断阿片受体，逆转呼吸抑制。BC 的阶梯是零点四、零点四、零点八、二毫克，肌注或静注，每三分钟加一级，直到血氧至少百分之九十四、呼吸超过十次。也可以鼻内给四毫克。和以前一样，先通气、测血糖。PCP 的变化在途径：如果病人一直昏迷、没有呼吸，你可以开静脉、静脉给纳洛酮，大约一分钟起效，而不是三分钟。逆转得快，也可能更快出现躁动和戒断反应，要有准备。

slides.title: Pain: acetaminophen and ibuprofen
slides.body:
AcetaminophenIbuprofen
Adult dose500–1,000 mg PO; may repeat once after 4 h300–400 mg PO every 4–6 h
Daily max4,000 mg from all sources; 2,000 mg with liver disease, heavy alcohol use, malnutrition1,200 mg
Child (pain)no BC child dose listed10 mg/kg; repeat once after 6 h; max 40 mg/kg/day
Key stopsany dose in last 4 h; severe liver disease; suspected overdoseNSAID allergy; GI bleed or ulcer; pregnancy; anticoagulants

The two may be used together for pain.
slides.say: Now pain relief by mouth. Acetaminophen is five hundred to one thousand milligrams, and you may repeat it once after four hours. The daily maximum is four thousand milligrams from all sources, lowered to two thousand with liver disease, heavy alcohol use or malnutrition. Don't give it if any acetaminophen was taken in the last four hours, or if you suspect an overdose. Ibuprofen, an anti-inflammatory, is three to four hundred milligrams every four to six hours, up to one thousand two hundred a day. A child in pain gets ten milligrams per kilogram. No ibuprofen in pregnancy, with a stomach bleed or ulcer, or with anticoagulants, which are blood thinners.
slides.sayZh: 接下来是口服镇痛。对乙酰氨基酚五百到一千毫克，四小时后可再给一次。每日上限是所有来源合计四千毫克，有肝病、大量饮酒或营养不良的病人降到两千。过去四小时内用过任何对乙酰氨基酚，或怀疑过量，就不要给。布洛芬是抗炎药，三百到四百毫克，每四到六小时一次，每天最多一千二百毫克。儿童镇痛每公斤十毫克。孕期、消化道出血或溃疡、正在用抗凝药（也就是血液稀释剂）的病人不能给布洛芬。

slides.title: The PCP lines: fever and IV
slides.body:
• Ibuprofen for fever is marked "PCP: Pyrexia"
  • Adult fever: 300–400 mg PO every 4–6 h, max 1,200 mg/day
  • Child: under 39 °C, 5 mg/kg; 39 °C or more, 10 mg/kg
  • Child: every 4–6 h, max 40 mg/kg/day
  • Acetaminophen IV, 50 kg+: 1,000 mg/100 mL over 15 min, every 6 h
  • That bag runs at 66 gtts/min on a 10 gtts/mL set
  • The IV route needs an IV line, and only PCPs start IVs
slides.say: In the ibuprofen monograph, fever, or pyrexia, has its own lines labelled PCP. For an adult with fever, the dose is the same as for pain: three to four hundred milligrams every four to six hours, up to one thousand two hundred a day. For a child, the fever dose depends on the temperature: five milligrams per kilogram below thirty-nine degrees, and ten milligrams per kilogram at thirty-nine or above, every four to six hours, never more than forty per kilogram a day. Acetaminophen also has an IV form for patients fifty kilograms or more: one thousand milligrams over fifteen minutes. That route needs an IV, so it's yours now.
slides.sayZh: 布洛芬专论里，发热（pyrexia）单独列了几行，标着 PCP。成人发热剂量和镇痛一样：三百到四百毫克，每四到六小时一次，每天最多一千二百毫克。儿童发热剂量看体温：低于三十九度每公斤五毫克，三十九度及以上每公斤十毫克，每四到六小时一次，每天不超过每公斤四十毫克。对乙酰氨基酚还有静脉剂型，用于五十公斤及以上的病人：一千毫克，十五分钟滴完。这个途径需要静脉通路，所以现在归你了。

slides.q: A 20 kg child has a fever of 39.4 °C and no other problems. Which order is correct under BC?
options: Ibuprofen 100 mg PO, given by an EMR
Ibuprofen 200 mg PO, given by a PCP
Ibuprofen 400 mg PO, the adult dose
slides.say: Let's try one. A twenty-kilogram child has a fever of thirty-nine point four degrees and no other problems. Which order is correct under BC? A, ibuprofen one hundred milligrams by mouth, given by an EMR. B, ibuprofen two hundred milligrams by mouth, given by a PCP. C, ibuprofen four hundred milligrams, the adult dose. D, acetaminophen one thousand milligrams IV over fifteen minutes. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 来做一题。一个二十公斤的孩子发烧三十九点四度，没有其他问题。按 BC，哪个医嘱正确？A 布洛芬一百毫克口服，由 EMR 给；B 布洛芬二百毫克口服，由 PCP 给；C 布洛芬四百毫克，成人剂量；D 对乙酰氨基酚一千毫克静脉，十五分钟滴完。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B. Treating fever with ibuprofen is a PCP line in the BC monograph, and at thirty-nine degrees or higher the child dose is ten milligrams per kilogram: ten times twenty is two hundred milligrams. A uses the dose for a fever under thirty-nine, and fever treatment sits on the PCP side. C is the adult dose, far too much for twenty kilograms. D is wrong because the IV acetaminophen dose is only for patients fifty kilograms or more.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B。用布洛芬退热在 BC 专论里是 PCP 的条目，三十九度及以上儿童剂量是每公斤十毫克：十乘二十等于二百毫克。A 用的是三十九度以下的剂量，而且退热属于 PCP 的范围。C 是成人剂量，对二十公斤的孩子太多了。D 错，因为静脉对乙酰氨基酚的剂量只适用于五十公斤及以上的病人。

slides.title: Inhaled pain relief
slides.body:
EntonoxMethoxyflurane
Doseself-administered3 mL; repeat after 20 min; max 6 mL
Onsetrapid1–3 min (8–10 breaths)
Key stopsaltered LOC, pneumothorax, air embolism, decompression sickness, inhalation injury, nitro in last 5 min, can't ventilate the spaceunder 18, pregnancy or breastfeeding, decreased LOC or head injury, kidney disease, tetracyclines, malignant hyperthermia

Before Entonox: primary survey, pain assessment, vitals with SpO₂; invert the cylinder 3 times; vent on.
slides.say: Two inhaled options, both held by the patient. Entonox, a mix of nitrous oxide and oxygen, works fast. The gas spreads into trapped air spaces, so it's contraindicated with a pneumothorax, an air embolism or decompression sickness, and also with altered consciousness, an inhalation injury, nitro in the last five minutes, or a space you can't ventilate. Methoxyflurane is three millilitres in the inhaler, repeated once after twenty minutes, six millilitres in total. No methoxyflurane under eighteen, in pregnancy or breastfeeding, with a decreased level of consciousness or head injury, or with kidney disease. Neither drug has a PCP-only line: the rules are the same for both licences.
slides.sayZh: 两种吸入药，都由病人自己拿着吸。Entonox 是笑气和氧气的混合气，起效快。这种气体会进入体内封闭的含气空间，所以气胸、空气栓塞、减压病禁用；意识改变、吸入性损伤、五分钟内用过硝酸甘油、所在空间无法通风也禁用。甲氧氟烷每次三毫升装入吸入器，二十分钟后可再给一次，总量六毫升。未满十八岁、怀孕或哺乳、意识下降或头部外伤、有肾病的病人不能用。这两种药都没有 PCP 专属条目，两种执照规则相同。

slides.title: For the BC exam: book vs BC
slides.body:
• Nitro: the book stops below systolic 100; BC stops below 110
  • ASA: the book gives 160–325 mg; BC gives 160 mg
  • Child epinephrine IM: book max 0.3 mg; BC max 0.5 mg
  • Salbutamol MDI: the book's puff is 90 mcg; BC uses 100 mcg
  • Glucagon: BC also allows 3 mg intranasal
slides.say: Your pharmacology textbook is American, so some numbers differ from BC, and on the BC exams you use the BC numbers. Nitroglycerin: the book holds it below a systolic of one hundred; BC holds it below one hundred ten. Aspirin: the book allows one hundred sixty to three hundred twenty-five milligrams; BC gives one hundred sixty. Epinephrine for a child: the book caps it at zero point three milligrams; BC caps it at zero point five. The book's salbutamol inhaler gives ninety micrograms a puff; BC counts in puffs of one hundred. And in BC, glucagon can also be given as three milligrams intranasal.
slides.sayZh: 药理课本是美国的，所以有些数字和 BC 不同，BC 的考试一律用 BC 的数字。硝酸甘油：课本收缩压低于一百不给，BC 是低于一百一十不给。阿司匹林：课本给一百六十到三百二十五毫克，BC 给一百六十毫克。儿童肾上腺素：课本上限零点三毫克，BC 上限零点五毫克。沙丁胺醇吸入器：课本每喷九十微克，BC 按每喷一百微克算。另外在 BC，胰高血糖素还可以鼻内给三毫克。

slides.title: EMR vs PCP: the familiar drugs
slides.body:
All licence levels (EMR + PCP)

  • ASA, nitro, then Entonox for chest pain
  • Oral glucose; glucagon if the airway isn't protected
  • Salbutamol for asthma/COPD
  • Epinephrine IM for anaphylaxis
  • Naloxone IM or IN
  • Acetaminophen PO, ibuprofen for pain, inhaled analgesia

PCP adds

  • IV with running fluid; dimenhydrinate for nausea
  • IV and D10W first; glucagon only if no IV
  • Salbutamol + ipratropium; salbutamol after epi
  • Epinephrine IM for severe bronchospasm
  • IV naloxone if still unconscious and apneic
  • Ibuprofen for fever; IV acetaminophen
slides.say: Here's the whole picture, row by row. Chest pain: both licences give aspirin, nitro and Entonox; the PCP adds an IV with running fluid and dimenhydrinate for nausea. Low sugar: both give oral glucose, and the EMR gives glucagon; the PCP goes IV and D10W first. Breathing: both give salbutamol; the PCP adds ipratropium, and salbutamol after epinephrine in anaphylaxis. Epinephrine: both give it for anaphylaxis; the PCP adds severe bronchospasm. Naloxone: both give it IM or intranasal; the PCP can go IV. Pain and fever: both treat pain; the PCP adds ibuprofen for fever, and IV acetaminophen.
slides.sayZh: 一行一行看全貌。胸痛：两种执照都给阿司匹林、硝酸甘油和 Entonox；PCP 加静脉输液和止恶心的茶苯海明。低血糖：都给口服葡萄糖，EMR 给胰高血糖素；PCP 先开静脉给 D10W。呼吸：都给沙丁胺醇；PCP 加异丙托溴铵，过敏性休克时在肾上腺素后加沙丁胺醇。肾上腺素：都用于过敏性休克；PCP 加严重支气管痉挛。纳洛酮：都能肌注或鼻喷；PCP 可以静脉给。疼痛和发热：都能镇痛；PCP 加布洛芬退热和静脉对乙酰氨基酚。

slides.title: New for you as a PCP: watch out for
slides.body:
• Acetaminophen max counts all sources and routes
  • ASA counts the patient's own dose; nitro's 3-dose limit doesn't
  • No Entonox within 5 min of nitro
  • Ibuprofen: no anticoagulants, no pregnancy, no GI bleed
  • IV naloxone works in 1 min: ventilate first, expect agitation
  • Glucagon is your backup now: IV and D10W first
slides.say: Now the traps. First, count every source: the acetaminophen maximum includes what the patient took at home and anything given IV. Second, don't confuse two rules: for aspirin, the patient's own dose before you arrived is a contraindication, but nitro's limit of three doses ignores what they took. Third, no Entonox within five minutes of nitro. Fourth, ibuprofen has hard stops you must ask about: blood thinners, pregnancy and stomach bleeding. Fifth, IV naloxone works within a minute, so ventilate first and expect agitation. And sixth, don't reach for glucagon out of habit. As a PCP, the IV and D10W come first.
slides.sayZh: 现在讲陷阱。第一，所有来源都要算：对乙酰氨基酚的上限包括病人在家吃的和静脉给的。第二，别搞混两条规则：阿司匹林，病人到场前自己吃过就是禁忌；硝酸甘油的三次上限却不算病人自己用的。第三，硝酸甘油五分钟内不能用 Entonox。第四，布洛芬有必须问清楚的硬禁忌：抗凝药、怀孕、消化道出血。第五，静脉纳洛酮一分钟内起效，要先通气，预料到病人会躁动。第六，别习惯性地先拿胰高血糖素，当 PCP 时先开静脉给 D10W。

slides.title: Three things to remember
slides.body:
1. You keep all 11 EMR drugs, at the BC doses
  2. PCP lines: epi for severe bronchospasm, ibuprofen for fever, IV routes
  3. Glucagon becomes the backup; salbutamol pairs with ipratropium

Next: new PCP drugs: glucose, nausea and allergy
slides.say: Three things to remember. One: you keep all eleven EMR drugs, and on the BC exams you use the BC doses, not the textbook's. Two: the PCP lines inside these drugs are epinephrine for severe bronchospasm, ibuprofen for fever, and the IV routes for naloxone and acetaminophen. Three: some old habits change. Glucagon becomes your backup behind the IV and D10W, and salbutamol now teams up with ipratropium. Next lesson, we start the new PCP drugs: D10W for low sugar, ondansetron and dimenhydrinate for nausea, and diphenhydramine for allergy. If anything was unclear, tap Ask. See you next class.
slides.sayZh: 收尾三句话。一，十一种 EMR 药你全部保留，BC 考试用 BC 剂量，不用课本的。二，这些药里的 PCP 条目是：肾上腺素用于严重支气管痉挛、布洛芬退热，以及纳洛酮和对乙酰氨基酚的静脉途径。三，一些老习惯要改：胰高血糖素退到静脉和 D10W 之后当备用，沙丁胺醇现在和异丙托溴铵搭档。下节课开始讲 PCP 新药：低血糖用的 D10W、止吐的昂丹司琼和茶苯海明、抗过敏的苯海拉明。有不懂的点「Ask」。下节课见。
